info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-Create Insurance Claims Claims Submit-v4-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Submission API enables users to submit insurance claims in a batch manner efficiently. Designed for insurers and claims adjusters, this API allows businesses to streamline the claims process by uploading multiple claims at once. It supports various claim types, ensuring a comprehensive handling of submissions. Typical consumers include insurance companies looking to automate claims processing and organizations aiming to enhance operational efficiency.

post.description: This endpoint allows the user to submit a new claim. Ensure that all required information is included in the request for successful processing.

requestBody.description: Submit a new claim with the necessary details. Ensure that all required fields are populated to successfully create a claim.

200.description: Request completed successfully and response includes the submitted claim details.

CreateInsuranceClaimsClaimsSubmitRequest.title: Claim Submission Request Body

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A number used to reference the claim.

customer.description: Details of the customer associated with the claim.

resource.description: The resource related to the claim.

priority.description: The priority level of the claim, where higher values indicate higher priority.

amount.description: The monetary amount associated with the claim.

currency.description: The currency code for the amount.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required upon claim processing.

requestedAt.description: The date and time when the claim was requested, formatted as an ISO 8601 string.

channel.description: The channel through which the claim was submitted.

recordIndex.description: An index to identify the record in a list of claims.
